feed_title: Pillow Dog Bed Mattress, Sherpa Fleece Top, Green Stonewashed Fabric, Medium 100 x 65cm and Large 120 x 80cm, Washable Cover | PawLunova Seathwaite
descriptionHtml:
Sherpa on top. Green stonewashed outside. No sides at all.

Seathwaite is an open sherpa-lined pillow dog mattress in green stonewashed fabric, in Medium (100 × 65 × 20cm) and Large (120 × 80 × 20cm).

Some dogs will not lie in anything with sides. They sprawl diagonally, one leg hanging off a corner, shifting position four times an hour. Put a bolstered bed down and you find them on the tiles beside it, chin on the rim they refused to climb.

There is nothing here to refuse. A flat pillow mattress with a sherpa surface, so they land from whatever angle they arrive at, with warmth in the pile above a cold floor.

What they get

  • No sides at all: Nothing around the edge, so they can land on it at any angle.
  • Sherpa where they lie: A soft, warm sleeping surface over virgin fibre cushioning.
  • Soft, not firm: Fibre filled by design. For firm support, see our memory foam mattresses.
  • Leather handles and a washable cover: Move it one-handed from the kitchen to beside the sofa. The cover washes at 30°C.

Best for: Diagonal sprawlers, dogs who refuse bolsters, and cold kitchen floors in winter.

Why it is worth the money

£79 for the Medium and £89 for the Large goes into the surface, because on this bed the surface is the product. Green stonewashed fabric, sherpa lining and leather handles are the parts you touch and look at every day, and they are the first things cut on a cheaper bed. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Sherpa is warm, which is the point of it in January and the drawback in July. If your dog abandons every bed in the house for cold tiles the moment the weather turns, this is their winter bed.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Medium100 × 65 × 20
Large120 × 80 × 20

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and machine wash at 30°C. Air-dry only. The leather handles have their own care instructions.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Nothing is lost to sides, so measure them and compare against 100cm or 120cm.

What is sherpa like to lie on?

A soft, warm pile surface sitting over virgin fibre cushioning rather than a firm core.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We can only describe it: open on all four sides, fibre filled, soft rather than firm. Speak to your vet about what they need underneath them.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover comes off for a 30°C machine wash and then air-dries. Do not tumble it.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

For the sprawler who will not be hemmed in.
